employees.change_hint: Branch, department, manager, job title and status changes are recorded in the employee history with this effective date.
employees.periods_hint: Payroll eligibility follows these periods: an employee appears only in payroll periods that overlap one of them.

settings.title: HR settings
settings.subtitle: Center-wide defaults for attendance, leave and payroll

attendance.count_after_grace: Count lateness from shift start once grace is exceeded
attendance.location_monitoring_enabled: Periodic location checks after electronic check-in

leave.annual_days_after_five_years: Annual leave days after five years of service

employees.number_prefix: Used for new employee numbers, for example EMP0001

payroll.changes_locked_until: Salary, insurance and shift changes cannot take effect on or before this date (closed payroll periods)

attendance.count_after_grace: Off: only the minutes after the grace period count as late. On: arriving after the grace period counts all minutes from the shift start.
attendance.punch_window_minutes: How far before a shift starts or after it ends a check-in or check-out is still attributed to that shift (30 to 720)
attendance.manual_entry_max_days_back: How many days back attendance can be entered or corrected manually (0 to 366). Older dates need the historical records permission; closed payroll periods are always locked.
attendance.max_gps_accuracy_meters: Website check-in: a location reading less precise than this cannot verify that the employee is at the work location (10 to 2000)
attendance.location_monitoring_enabled: While an employee with GPS verification is checked in, their location is verified periodically during working hours. Failed or missed checks never mark the employee absent.
attendance.location_check_interval_minutes: Between 5 and 240. Applies to sessions that start after the change.
attendance.mobile_device_approval_required: Future mobile application: a newly registered device can send locations only after HR approves it.

workflows.title: Approval workflows
workflows.fallback_hint: Request types without an active workflow need one approval from any user holding the permission "{permission}".

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: HR requests awaiting your decision and the requests you submitted
approvals.empty_awaiting: Nothing is waiting for your approval.

audit.title: HR audit log
audit.subtitle: Every change to HR records with old and new values

records.confirm_cancel: Cancel this scheduled change? The previous record becomes open-ended again.
records.effective_dated_hint: Salary records are never edited: a change creates a new record from its effective date, so earlier payroll periods keep the amounts in force at the time.
records.insurance_rates_hint: Enter the GOSI contribution rates in force for this employee. Rates are percentages of the contributory wage.
records.locked_until: Payroll is locked until {date}: changes must take effect after this date.

documents.file_hint: PDF, image, Word or Excel, up to {size} MB

history.hint: Every change is kept with its effective date; history is never edited.

attendance_setup.title: Attendance setup
attendance_setup.subtitle: Shifts and attendance policies assigned to employees
attendance_setup.overnight_hint: Overnight shift: ends the next day

validation.id_number_invalid: Enter a valid 10-digit National ID or Iqama number
validation.id_number_nationality_mismatch: Saudi nationals use a National ID (starts with 1); residents use an Iqama number (starts with 2)

map.click_to_pick: Click on the map to place the work location
map.picker_hint: Click the map or drag the pin to set the coordinates. The circle shows the allowed GPS radius.
map.location_unavailable: Your current location is not available in this browser.
map.missing_coordinates_hint: Locations without coordinates are not drawn; GPS attendance cannot be used with them.

assignments.title: Branch and work location
assignments.hint: Every transfer is a new record from its effective date, so earlier periods keep the branch and location in force at the time. GPS attendance uses the location in force on the attendance day.
assignments.effective_hint: A future date schedules the transfer; it takes effect automatically on that day.

shifts.expected_default: Leave empty to use the shift length minus break ({value})
shifts.fixed_break_hint: The break is taken at a fixed time; presence during it is not counted as work.
shifts.floating_break_hint: Floating break: the break minutes are deducted from the time worked inside the shift.
shifts.rest_days_hint: Days that are neither working nor rest days are treated as off days.
shifts.rotation_hint: The cycle repeats every {days} days and includes {rest} rest days. Each employee can start on a different cycle day.
shifts.grace_inherit_hint: Leave empty to use the attendance policy or HR settings
shifts.effective_change_hint: This shift is already assigned. Timing changes are effective-dated so past attendance keeps the hours that applied at the time.
shifts.assign_branch_hint: Assigns the shift to every current employee of the branch from the effective date
shifts.set_as_branch_default: Also use as the default shift for new hires in this branch
shifts.history_hint: Each version applies from its effective date until the next one
shifts.confirm_deactivate: Deactivate this shift? It can no longer be assigned.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.click_hint: Click a day to add an exception or a temporary change
schedule.grace_summary: Grace: late {late} min, early leave {early} min
schedule.rotation_offset_hint: Which day of the rotation cycle this employee works on the effective date

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.confirm_cancel: Cancel this exception? The regular schedule will apply again.

policies.check_in_after_hint: Leave empty to accept check-in until the shift ends
policies.check_out_before_hint: Leave empty to accept check-out any time after the shift starts
policies.window_preview: Example for a {shift} shift: check-in accepted {check_in}, check-out accepted {check_out}.
policies.absence_after_hint: Leave empty to never mark late arrivals as absent
policies.shift_grace_hint: A shift can define its own grace periods; an employee-specific grace period overrides the late grace.
policies.duplicate_window_hint: Punches closer together than this are treated as duplicates
policies.allow_manual_hint: Manual employees can only use policies that allow manual attendance
policies.effective_change_hint: This policy has been used. Rule changes create a new version from the date below (today or later); attendance before that date keeps the previous rules. Name and description changes apply immediately.
policies.history_hint: Every rule version with the dates it applied. Attendance is evaluated with the version in force on each day.
policies.window_legend: Windows are in minutes relative to the shift: check-in before / after the shift start, check-out before / after the shift end. Grace shows late / early departure.
policies.employees_hint: Employed staff whose attendance configuration uses this policy now or from a scheduled date
policies.confirm_deactivate: Deactivate this policy? It cannot be assigned to employees until it is activated again.
policies.confirm_activate: Activate this policy so it can be assigned to employees?
policies.already_scheduled: A rule change is already scheduled from {date}. A new change must start after it; to replace it, cancel it from the rule history first.

mode_hints.electronic: Checks in and out on the website, with GPS verification per policy
mode_hints.manual: HR enters check-in and check-out; no GPS required

attendance_config.no_policy_hint: Without a policy the center attendance settings apply
attendance_config.shift_hint: Changing the shift here assigns it from the same effective date
attendance_config.no_gps_exempt: Exempt employees are not tracked, so no GPS is required.
attendance_config.manual_blocked_policy: The selected policy does not allow manual attendance.
attendance_config.manual_blocked_center: The center attendance settings do not allow manual attendance. Choose a policy that allows it.
attendance_config.gps_needs_location: GPS verification is required: choose a work location that has coordinates.
attendance_config.dialog_hint: Changes take effect from the effective start date; earlier attendance keeps the previous configuration.
attendance_config.scheduled_hint: This change is scheduled: the current configuration stays in force until the effective date.
attendance_config.history_hint: The previous configuration is kept in the history and still applies to dates before the effective date.
attendance_config.history_subtitle: Each change applies from its effective date; past records are never rewritten
attendance_config.create_without_permission: The employee starts with manual attendance. A user allowed to configure attendance can change the method and policy from the profile.

my_attendance.title: My attendance
my_attendance.subtitle: Check in and out at your work location
my_attendance.locating: Getting your location. Allow location access if the browser asks.
my_attendance.load_failed: Your attendance status could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
my_attendance.unexpected_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
my_attendance.network_error: Connection failed, so your attendance may not have been saved. Check your internet connection: the status refreshes when you are back online, and trying again will not create a duplicate.
my_attendance.offline: You are offline. Check-in and check-out need an internet connection.
my_attendance.sent_for_review: Recorded and sent to HR for review
my_attendance.under_review: This attendance is flagged for HR review
my_attendance.accuracy_tip: Turn on precise location / GPS, step away from tall buildings or move near a window, wait a few seconds and try again.
my_attendance.location_not_configured: Your work location has no GPS coordinates yet, so your location cannot be verified. Contact HR.
my_attendance.foreground_only: Your location is read only when you press Check in or Check out while this page is open. It is not tracked in the background: closing, minimizing or locking the page records nothing.

gps.required: Required: you must be within the allowed radius
gps.flexible: Checked: attempts outside the radius are sent to HR for review

hints.check_in_closed: The check-in window closed at {time}. Contact HR if you are at work.
hints.checked_out: Your attendance for this shift is complete.
hints.missing_check_out: This shift was closed without a check-out. Contact HR if this is wrong.
hints.no_shift: No shift is scheduled for you now.
hints.not_employed_yet: Your employment has not started yet.
hints.recorded_manually: HR has recorded your attendance for this shift manually. Contact HR to correct it.

ineligible.not_employee: Your account is not linked to an employee profile in this center, so electronic attendance is not available. Contact HR.
ineligible.not_employed: Your employee profile is deactivated, so attendance cannot be recorded.
ineligible.manual: Your attendance is recorded manually by HR. Electronic check-in is not available for you.
ineligible.exempt: You are exempt from attendance recording.

location_errors.permission_denied: Location access is blocked for this site. Open the site settings (the icon next to the address), allow Location, then try again.
location_errors.position_unavailable: Your device could not determine its location. Turn on location services (GPS) and try again.
location_errors.timeout: Getting your location took too long. Move to an open area or near a window and try again.
location_errors.unsupported: This browser does not support location. Use an up-to-date Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
location_errors.insecure_context: Location only works over a secure (https) connection. Contact your administrator.

review_reasons.auto_check_out: checked out automatically at the shift end
review_reasons.left_work_location: Outside the work location during the shift

my_attendance.foreground_only_monitored: Your location is read when you press Check in or Check out and, while you are checked in, at each periodic location check during your working hours, only while this page is open and visible. It is not tracked in the background or after check-out: checks that fall while the page is closed or the device is locked are recorded as missed, not as absence.

attendance_log.title: Attendance records
attendance_log.subtitle: Electronic check-ins and check-outs with their location verification, and attendance entered by HR

attendance_records.title: Attendance records
attendance_records.subtitle: Electronic and manual attendance in one place, with entry, correction and change history
attendance_records.add_subtitle: Attendance entered by HR: no GPS needed
attendance_records.shift_hint: Leave empty to use the employee's schedule; choose a shift only if they worked another one.
attendance_records.shift_locked: The shift of an electronic record cannot be changed.
attendance_records.shift_overridden: The shift differs from the one scheduled that day
attendance_records.set_dates: Set check-in / check-out dates manually (otherwise placed automatically, overnight shifts included)
attendance_records.modification_reason_hint: Kept in the change history with the previous and new values.
attendance_records.electronic_correction_note: This record was recorded electronically. Correcting it keeps the electronic method and the GPS evidence of the times you do not change; corrected times are marked as entered manually.
attendance_records.preview_empty: Choose the employee and date to see the scheduled shift and the result.
attendance_records.preview_failed: The result could not be calculated.
attendance_records.limits_days: You can enter or correct attendance for the last {days} days (from {date}).
attendance_records.limits_historical: You can enter and correct historical attendance.
attendance_records.limits_locked: Attendance on or before {date} is locked (closed payroll).
attendance_records.bulk_subtitle: Enter the attendance of several employees for one day
attendance_records.bulk_ready: {ready} of {selected} selected employees have times entered
attendance_records.import_subtitle: Rows are checked first; nothing is saved until you confirm
attendance_records.import_template_hint: Optionally prefill it with the manual-attendance employees who have no record on a date. Times are HH:MM; a check-out earlier than the check-in is placed on the next day.
attendance_records.history_empty: No manual changes: this record was recorded electronically and never corrected.

entry_reasons.field_work: Field work outside the work location

warnings.shift_overridden: A different shift than the scheduled one is used for the calculation.
warnings.off_schedule: No shift is scheduled that day: lateness and early departure are not calculated.
warnings.electronic_employee: This employee normally records attendance electronically.
warnings.missing_check_in: No check-in: the record stays incomplete until it is corrected.
warnings.missing_check_out: No check-out: the record stays incomplete until it is corrected.
warnings.requires_justification: The attendance policy requires a justification for this lateness or early departure; the record will be flagged for review.
warnings.historical: Historical date: older than the usual manual entry limit.

location_monitoring.title: Location monitoring
location_monitoring.subtitle: Periodic GPS verification of electronic attendance sessions
location_monitoring.every: Every {minutes} minutes during your working hours
location_monitoring.outside_alert: Your last location was outside the allowed radius of your work location. HR will review it.
location_monitoring.missed_note: Some checks were missed while this page was closed or in the background. Keep the page open during your shift so your location can be verified.
location_monitoring.privacy_note: Your location is checked only while you are checked in, during your working hours, and while this page is open. Monitoring stops at check-out.
location_monitoring.privacy_hr: Locations are recorded only during attendance sessions (from check-in to check-out, within working hours). A failed or missed check is never treated as absence; outside-radius alerts are for review only.
location_monitoring.network_retry: No connection: the location check will be sent again automatically.
location_monitoring.server_retry: The server could not record the check right now; it will be retried shortly.
location_monitoring.distance: {distance} m from the work location (allowed {radius} m)
location_monitoring.no_sessions: No attendance sessions for these filters
location_monitoring.load_failed: Location monitoring data could not be loaded.
location_monitoring.map_note: The map shows the last verified position of employees currently checked in, over their work locations' allowed radius.
location_monitoring.not_monitored_count: {count} open sessions without location checks (GPS verification not required or no work location).
location_monitoring.review_note: The review is recorded for follow-up only; the attendance record is not changed.

reasons.services_disabled: Location services disabled on the device
reasons.background_restricted: Background location restricted on the device

devices.confirm_approve: Approve this device? The employee's previous active device will be revoked.
devices.confirm_revoke: Revoke this device? It will no longer be able to send locations.
devices.note: Devices registered by the future mobile application. Each employee has at most one active device.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.hint: Holiday days are never counted as absence and are not deducted from leave balances. Attendance already processed for these days is recalculated automatically.

leave.title: Leave management
leave.subtitle: Leave requests, balances and configurable leave types
leave.working_days_hint: Weekly rest days and official holidays inside the period are not counted.
leave.attachments_required: Supporting documents are required for this leave type.
leave.attachments_hint: Up to {max} files, {size} MB each (PDF, images, Word).
leave.too_many_files: You can attach up to {max} files.
leave.record_as_approved_hint: For leave already approved outside the system: skips the approval workflow and deducts the balance immediately.
leave.cancel_approved_hint: Cancelling an approved leave returns its days to the balance and reprocesses the attendance of those days.
leave.balances_hint: Balances are created automatically from the leave type rules. Click a balance to see its transactions.
leave.adjust_days_hint: Added to or deducted from the {year} balance.
leave.carry_over_hint: Unused days moved to the next year (0 = none).
leave.annual_mode_hint: The annual entitlement follows the HR settings (days per year, and after five years of service), prorated for the first year of service.

my_leave.title: My leave
my_leave.subtitle: Your leave balances, requests and their approval status
my_leave.not_eligible: Leave requests are available to employees registered in HR. Contact HR if you think this is a mistake.

attendance_processing.title: Attendance processing
attendance_processing.subtitle: Daily attendance results, exceptions and payroll periods
attendance_processing.process_hint: Recalculates the selected days from shifts, attendance records, rest days, holidays, approved leave and attendance policies (up to 62 days). HR corrections are kept; days of approved payroll periods are not changed.
attendance_processing.review_only_hint: This is not a working day: only confirming the exception as reviewed is possible.
attendance_processing.correction_reason_hint: Required (at least 5 characters); stored in the correction history and the audit log.
attendance_processing.periods_hint: Process a period to build each employee's summary, review its exceptions, then approve it: the days are locked and only approved figures are provided to payroll. Periods of the same branch cannot overlap, so no day is counted twice.
attendance_processing.confirm_approve: Approve this period? Its attendance days will be locked and its figures provided to payroll.
attendance_processing.reopen_hint: Reopening unlocks the days of the period and withdraws its figures from payroll until it is approved again.
attendance_processing.not_approved_hint: Figures of a period that is not approved can still change and are not provided to payroll.

additional_days.title: Additional working days
additional_days.subtitle: Additional days worked on rest days, days off and holidays, their approval and payroll
additional_days.confirm_submit: Submit {count} additional day record(s) for approval?
additional_days.days_only_hint: Payroll pays additional days only (full or half days), never overtime hours.
additional_days.formula_hint: Approved additional days are paid with the payroll period that covers them: amount = (gross salary ÷ 30) × days. Days approved after their period was closed are carried forward to the next period.
additional_days.edit_pending_hint: This record is awaiting approval: saving changes cancels the current approval and submits it again.
additional_days.employees_hint: The same day is recorded for every selected employee.
additional_days.submit_now_hint: Otherwise the records are saved as drafts and can be edited before submitting.
